title: Acquisition Support Services Contract (ASSC) for all FAA Acquisition and Contracting Organizations
description: Update 04 Released: 8/18/2026 This announcement is being extended from 10/01/2026 to 11/01/2026. Interested vendors should expect a soliciation to be released on or around the closing of this announcement. The following Q&A regarding Update 03 below is released: QUESTION 1: "If a prospective offeror has past performance or current work on an FAA acquisition support contract that does not have a CPARS reference, can we solicit a past performance questionnaire from the client in lieu of CPARS?" FAA RESPONSE: Please note that the criteria outlined in Update 03 below are draft only and subject to change at this time; however, if this criteria were to be used verbatim, the short answer would be "No." QUESTION 2: "Would the FAA consider lowering the threshold for past performance so that it is less restrictive to small businesses? A lower threshold would allow a larger pool of small business concerns to participate." FAA RESPONSE: Although the FAA's internal total estimated potential value for this scope is sensitive and will not be released, please note that it is significantly higher than $10M. This threshold has been carefully considered and is tentatively determined to be the lowest we can set to ensure an offeror has sufficient past performance experience comparable in magnitude, thereby mitigating award risk to the FAA. QUESTION 3: "Has the FAA made a determination as to the type of contract?" FAA RESPONSE: No. This is subject to change until the solicitation is publicly released. QUESTION 4: "The requirement states that annual reporting with performance ratings can be provided in CPARS. Although AMS requires CPARS, many of our customers do not complete them. Would the FAA consider accepting Past Performance Questionnaires (PPQ) instead?" FAA RESPONSE: If your company has performed contracts requiring CPARS reporting and needs CPARS submissions completed to be eligible for award, there is likely still time to have this completed before proposals are evaluated if you contact your respective Contracting Officer to address this. At this time PPQs are not anticipated to be acceptable substitute in lieu of discoverable CPARS reports. QUESTION 5: "If my company has fewer than 3 examples that meet all criteria, can I submit past performance examples possessed by my intended teaming partners?" FAA RESPONSE: This is yet to be determined; however, the FAA's notes this consideration to ensure this question is clearly answered in the forthcoming solicitation package and the solicitations Section L (Instructions to Offerors). It is recommended that companies intending to use teaming partners familiarize themselves with AMS 3.2.2.7-8 Disclosure of Team Arrangements (April 2008). The FAA currently intends to require disclosure of teaming arrangements in offers. (end of update) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 03 Released: 7/28/2026 The FAA thanks all industry members who have provided feedback on this announcement so far. The information was very helpful. The purpose of this update is to provide an estimated magnitude of the scope, provide draft past performance minimum requirements, and to state the FAA�s intent to determine the nature of forthcoming competition. An estimated total number of personnel of various labor categories, their respective organizations, and geographic locations are as follows: AAQ-200 (DC): 9 Full Time Equivalent (FTE) AAQ-300 (DC): 5 FTE AAQ-400 (DC): 1 FTE AAQ-500 (DFW): 3 FTE AAQ-500 (SEA): 6 FTE AAQ-500 (BOS): 1 FTE AAQ-500 (ATL): 4 FTE AAQ-600 (NJ): 4 FTE AAQ-700 (OKC): 21 FTE Total estimated number of direct support personnel: 54 FTE Total estimated number of separate geographic locations: 7 Total anticipated Period of Performance: 10 Years The information provided above should be viewed as estimates only and is subject to change. A more detailed breakdown of labor categories, quantities, and locations will be provided when pricing information is solicited. The point of contact (POC) for this announcement is seeking to confirm who, if any, interested vendors possesses past performance can meet the following criteria: Possess at least three (3) examples of past performance, similar in scope (acquisition support services). Each example is completed or was ongoing within the last seven (7) years. Each example is valued at $10 million or higher. Annual reporting with performance ratings for each example can be found in CPARS. The nature of the competition has not yet been determined. Any solicitation resulting from this announcement may be open and unrestricted or set aside for small businesses, SBA 8(a) program participants, Woman-Owned Small Businesses (WOSB), Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB), or HUBZone concerns. Responses to this update will assist the FAA in determining whether a set-aside is appropriate for the forthcoming solicitation. RESPONSE REQUESTED This is not a solicitation for specific past performance data. Please do not attempt to submit specific past performance data in response to this announcement. It will not be evaluated at this time if received. The point of contact (POC) for this announcement is seeking confirmation from interested offerors who can meet the draft recency and relevancy criteria outlined above. If your company is interested in submitting a proposal and can meet these criteria, please provide a brief, but clear, response to the POC of this announcement no later than 1600 (Central) on August 5, 2026 to confirm. (end of update) -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Update 02 Released: 7/1/2026 The FAA is considering a competitive award strategy focusing on base contract year pricing, with past performance potentially prioritized over the lowest price. Currently, past performance is contemplated to be slightly more important than price. The FAA is considering the incorporation of terms for annual adjustments based on the 'Total Increase' amount in the header of the General Schedule (GS) salary tables, relevant to geographic location. These salary tables are publicly accessible at the following website: https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/pay-leave/salaries-wages/2026/general-schedule This acquisition strategy is not yet finalized and subject to change. The FAA seeks a contract solution that is fair and reasonable, and mitigates future economic risks for both parties throughout the life of the contract. RESPONSE REQUESTED: The FAA seeks to confirm adequate competition exists if the contemplated strategy above is used. If your company has already responded to this announcement, please send a brief follow-up email to the POC of this announcement confirming your interest and intent to submit a competitive proposal if/when a solicitation is released. If your company has not yet submitted a response to this announcement, please read the full announcement below and respond accordingly. If you are interested but have concerns about this strategy, please propose an alternative that ensures fair annual adjustments and ensures all future option periods can be exercised unilaterally by the FAA throughout the life of the contract. title: Industry Day for Toll Management Solutions
description: Thank you for your participation and for submitting your questions to GSA Fleet Toll Management Solution RFI and Industry Day. This action is to post the Government's response to the RFI and Industry day questions and provide the link to the Industry Day event recording. The Government is seeking information from interested and qualified vendors that can provide nationwide tolling management services for a large federally leased vehicle fleet consisting of more than 230,000 vehicles, with the potential fleet size and associated requirements to increase over time as well as the possibility to include services for agency owned, non-postal service federal vehicles. Based on where these vehicles operate, the true number is likely closer to 200K with the possibility for 190K more. The Government requires a solution that can support toll payment and account management across the United States, including interoperability with multiple tolling authorities and toll collection systems and the ability to integrate with federal government billing and systems of record. Please see attached RFI and question matrix.

De skal også ta hensyn til moderne renhold og bidra til gode arbeidsforhold for våre egne ansatte. Oppdragsgiver har forståelse for at konkurransen er kompleks ift. type møbler/inventar som etterspørres, og forventer at tilbydere er avhengig av underleverandører for å levere et komplett tilbud. description: T-BOS Acquisition Update�19 Aug 2026: Notice of Scope Revision and Strategic Procurement Pause The 764th Enterprise Sourcing Squadron is issuing this update to inform industry of a significant scope revision and subsequent schedule delay for the T�rkiye Base Operating Support (T-BOS) acquisition. 1. Cancellation of Current Descoping Actions / Restoration of Current Requirement Following the conclusion of mediation between the U.S. Government and the Turkish labor union (T�rk Harb-??) regarding the new 2-year Collective Labor Agreement (CLA), the Government made a strategic decision to continue all BOS functions as a consolidated requirement. The previously announced strategy to immediately descope approximately 175 Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) positions from the core T-BOS solicitation has been cancelled 2. Impact on Local Contract Actions The 39th Contracting Squadron (39 CONS) at Incirlik AB is currently in the process of formally cancelling the four associated local contract actions and solicitations for these services. All offerors and awardees involved in those local 39 CONS actions will receive separate, direct communications from their respective Contracting Officers. 3. Once an updated plan is formally approved, the Government will post an additional update to outline the revised acquisition strategy, define the future procurement pathway, and publish a new milestone schedule. As part of this comprehensive reassessment, the Government may also issue supplemental requests for information or conduct additional market research to ensure our final approach aligns with current market capabilities. We appreciate the significant time and resources industry has already invested in reviewing our previous draft documents. La exigencia de este umbral se considera proporcionada a la entidad y complejidad de las obras, ya que permite garantizar que el contratista cuenta con experiencia acreditada en trabajos de naturaleza análoga, tales como pavimentaciones, firmes, asfaltados y actuaciones sobre infraestructuras viarias en servicio. La acreditación mediante relación de obras ejecutadas acompañada de certificados de buena ejecución constituye un medio idóneo para verificar la capacidad técnica del empresario, puesto que permite constatar no solo la experiencia previa en trabajos similares, sino también que éstos fueron ejecutados correctamente, dentro de los plazos establecidos y conforme a las reglas técnicas aplicables. La adecuación de este requisito resulta especialmente relevante en el presente contrato debido a la necesidad de compatibilizar la ejecución de las obras con el normal funcionamiento de las instalaciones hospitalarias, garantizando la seguridad de usuarios, personal sanitario y vehículos de emergencia, así como la correcta planificación de los trabajos para minimizar afecciones al acceso al Hospital.

title: Netherlands – Software package and information systems – Energie- Management Systeem
description: De Opdracht omvat de levering, implementatie en ondersteuning van een nieuw Energie- Management Systeem (EnMS) voor de Universiteit Leiden. Een goed functionerend Energieregistratie- en Bewakingssysteem (EBS) maakt integraal onderdeel uit van de EnMS-oplossing. Voor het merendeel van de gebouwen is een EBS wettelijk verplicht. De EnMS-oplossing dient daarom te voldoen aan de geldende richtlijnen zoals vastgesteld door de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland (RVO). Met deze aanbesteding beoogt de Opdrachtgever te beschikken over een schaalbare, toekomstbestendige en veilig ingerichte SaaS-oplossing die betrouwbare energie-informatie ontsluit en ondersteuning biedt bij wettelijke verplichtingen, financiële processen en duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen. Het EnMS fungeert daarbij als het primaire systeem voor langetermijnopslag, beheer en analyse van energiedata van de Opdrachtgever. Het EnMS dient op een robuuste en herleidbare wijze te integreren met bestaande systemen en databronnen van de Universiteit Leiden en geschikt te zijn voor gegevensuitwisseling binnen de bestaande informatievoorziening. De Opdracht bestaat uit de volgende onderdelen: de levering, implementatie en ondersteuning van een EnMS als SaaS-oplossing de levering van monitoringsdiensten gericht op datakwaliteit en continuïteit de levering van aanvullende functionaliteit modules en dashboards (optioneel) Voor onderdeel 3 geldt geen afnameverplichting. De Opdrachtgever wil modules en dashboards naar gelang van gebruik optioneel en afzonderlijk van elkaar kunnen afnemen gedurende de looptijd van de Overeenkomst. Het al dan niet volledig aanbieden van onderdeel 3 vormt geen uitsluitingsgrond. De mate waarin de functionaliteit van de uitgevraagde modules en/of dashboards wordt aangeboden, wordt wel betrokken bij de kwaliteitsbeoordeling van de inschrijving.

title: Norway – Health and social work services – Procurement of home services
description: Oslo municipality c/o the Norwegian Welfare Administration shall procure new framework agreements for home health services, hereafter called home services. The user choice in the home care service applies to persons with decisions on home nursing care or practical assistance who live or stay in Oslo municipality. The aim is to give users greater influence, flexibility and freedom of choice, by giving users the right to choose whether the service should be provided by a municipal executive or by a private service provider with a framework agreement. The users can choose a service provider for practical assistance and home nursing. The users can at any time choose new executing of their service offer. The aim of this procurement is to enter into framework agreements with private suppliers who ensure good and adapted services for the entire target group, as well as facilitate for functioning user choices. All users of home services shall receive equal services regardless of whether they choose municipal service provider or private service provider. The framework agreements shall create long-term predictability regarding service offers and finance for users, district and suppliers.

title: Finland – Medical equipments – Magneettikuvauslaite (3T MRI), Siun sote
description: Pohjois-Karjalan hyvinvointi alue hakee 3T MRI laitetta Joensuun keskussairaalaan, Kuvantamiskeskukseen/radiologiaan. Sairaalamme sijaitsee Joensuussa ja palvelee laajasti koko Pohjois Karjalan aluetta. Kuvantamisyksikössämme on tällä hetkellä käytössä kaksi Siemensin Sola 1,5T MRI laitetta, joilla kuvataan kattavasti kaikkia potilasryhmiä vauvasta ikääntyneisiin potilaisiin. Toimintamme kattaa myös vaativat potilasryhmät, mukaan lukien anestesiassa kuvattavat sekä implanttipotilaat. Kuvaamme laajasti eri anatomisia alueita, mutta tällä hetkellä emme tee MRI ohjattuja toimenpiteitä emmekä tutkimustoimintaa. Lisäksi Kuvantamiskeskuksessa leikekuvantamislaitteiden osalta käytössämme on kolme Siemensin tietokonetomografialaitetta sekä Siemensin SPECT- ja PET-järjestelmät. Radiologimme ja muut kuvantamiseen perehtyneet erikoislääkärit käyttävät lausuntotyössä Siemensin syngo.via työasemaratkaisua, jota hyödynnetään laajasti kaikissa leikekuvantamismodaliteeteissa, erityisesti TT- ja MRI kuvantamisessa, sekä soveltuvin osin myös SPECT ja PET tutkimuksissa. Hankittava uusi 3T MRI laite tulee olemaan sairaalamme ensimmäinen ja ainoa 3T tason järjestelmä. Laitetta tullaan alkuvaiheessa käyttämään erityisesti neuro-, tuki ja liikuntaelimistön (MSK), rintojen sekä eturauhasen kuvantamiseen. Lisäksi laitteella on tarkoitus suorittaa sydänkuvantamista, mukaan lukien kohdennetut tutkimukset iskeemisten muutosten diagnosointiin, sepelvaltimoiden anatomian arviointiin sekä sydänlihaksen perfuusion kuvantamiseen levossa ja rasituksessa. Tavoitteenamme on jatkossa laajentaa 3T tutkimusten käyttöä kattavasti, minkä vuoksi laitteen monipuolinen varustelu ja laajennettavuus ovat meille erittäin tärkeitä. Sairaalamme sijainti huomioiden arvostamme luotettavan, nopeasti saatavilla olevan ja kokeneen huollon merkitystä. Lisäksi koulutuksella on keskeinen rooli, koska kuvaustoimintaan osallistuu useita hoitajia. Edellytämme, että käyttökoulutus on saatavilla suomen kielellä. Myös huollon suomenkielinen palvelu katsotaan merkittäväksi väärinymmärrysten välttämiseksi. MRI järjestelmän käyttöliittymän yhtenäisyydellä ja käytettävyydellä on keskeinen merkitys yksikkömme toiminnan, koulutuksen ja teknisen ylläpidon kannalta. Yksikössämme henkilöstöresurssit ovat rajalliset, ja kuvaustoimintaan osallistuu useita käyttäjiä, minkä vuoksi uuden järjestelmän käyttöönoton ja koulutuksen tulee olla mahdollisimman sujuvaa ja tehokasta. Useiden erilaisten käyttöliittymien samanaikainen käyttö lisää merkittävästi koulutustarvetta, monimutkaistaa työnkulkua ja kasvattaa virheiden riskiä. Lisäksi henkilöstön irrottaminen kliinisestä potilastyöstä koulutukseen on haastavaa, mikä korostaa selkeän, intuitiivisen ja mahdollisimman yhdenmukaisen käyttöliittymän merkitystä. Vastaavasti yhtenäinen käyttöympäristö helpottaa myös IT ylläpitoa, päivityksiä ja tukipalveluita sekä parantaa järjestelmän kokonaisluotettavuutta. Tämän vuoksi pidämme tärkeänä, että tarjottu ratkaisu tukee mahdollisimman sujuvaa käyttöönottoa, tehokasta koulutusta ja hallittavaa ylläpitoa yksikön resurssit huomioiden. Ympäristövastuu on keskeinen arvo toiminnassamme. Edellytämme, että tarjottu MRI järjestelmä on valmistettu vastuullisesti ja sen ympäristökuormitus on mahdollisimman vähäinen. Hyväksymme myös tehdaskunnostetun laitteen, mikäli se täyttää vaaditut tekniset ja toiminnalliset kriteerit. Hankinta toteutetaan hankinnalle osoitettujen määrärahojen puitteissa. Hankintayksikkö pidättää oikeuden keskeyttää hankintamenettelyn, mikäli hyväksyttävissä olevien tarjousten hinnat ylittävät hankinnalle käytettävissä olevan määrärahan eikä hankintaa voida toteuttaa käytettävissä olevalla rahoituksella.

title: Norway – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Evaluation of Five Pilot Projects Testing Exemptions from Provisions of the Local Government Act, the Property Tax Act, the General Practitioner Regulations, and Other Regulatory Frameworks
description: In 2023, the Government invited municipalities and county authorities to apply to participate in the Government’s pilot scheme for municipalities and county authorities. The scheme allows municipalities to test new ways of carrying out their tasks through exemptions from existing regulations. These pilot projects are based on the Act relating to Experiments in Public Administration of 26 June 1992 (the Experimental Administration Act), hereinafter referred to as the Experimental Administration Act. Further information about the framework of the scheme is available on the Ministry’s webpage dedicated to the pilot scheme. This assignment involves evaluating the following five pilot projects: - A pilot project to operate a joint primary healthcare service within an inter-municipal cooperative arrangement involving four municipalities in the Inner Namdal region of Trøndelag (Grong, Lierne, Namsskogan and Røyrvik). - A pilot project in Nordre Follo Municipality aimed at improving dialogue between the municipal administration and elected representatives: Dialogue Phase. - A pilot project in Nordre Follo Municipality aimed at improving dialogue between elected representatives, the administration and residents: Task Forum. - A pilot project in Vestland County Municipality and 18 municipalities in the county concerning host municipality cooperation across local government levels in the fields of services for older persons and closed archives. - A pilot project in Oslo Municipality involving the delegation of decision-making authority in cases concerning the remission or reduction of property tax. Duration and Budget Framework The pilot projects will, as a general rule, run for up to four years from their commencement. The evaluation assignment will cover the entire pilot period and will also include follow-up work in connection with the preparation of the final report. The final report must be submitted no later than 1 November 2030. The contractor may be required to participate in meetings and/or gatherings with the municipalities participating in the pilot scheme, organized by the Norwegian Association of Local and Regional Authorities (KS) and/or the Ministry. The maximum budget for the procurement is NOK 8,000,000, excluding VAT. This amount includes all costs associated with the assignment. Payments will be made upon delivery of agreed deliverables, cf. Annex 5 to the contract. The procurement is subject to the Norwegian Parliament’s approval of the proposed budget. For a more detailed description of the deliverables, please refer to Annex 1 to the contract.

title: Denmark – Machines and apparatus for testing and measuring – One Photonic Wafer Probe Station and one Photonic Assembly Station
description: This tender concerns DTU Nano's planned procurement of a Photonic Assembly Station and a Photonic Wafer Probe Station. The tender is split into to two lots – one for each of the two stations. Tenderers may choose to bid on one or both lots, which will be evaluated and awarded individually. The assembly station is for connecting fibre array units (FAUs) to an optical chip. The type of connection will be edge coupling using waveguides loops for alignment but if necessary, the alignment can also be performed either using the light source on the chip (if it exists) or by using an external light source and connecting two FAUs, one on each side of the chip. Thus, the main purpose of the machine is to do assembly and fiber attachment of photonic chips. The system shall support research, prototyping, process development, pilot manufacturing, and low-volume production activities within DTU Nano's advanced fabrication facility. DTU has activities within Silicon Photonics (SiPh), Photonic Integrated Circuits (PICs), Optical transceivers, Laser modules, Photodetectors, Fiber-optic assemblies, Co-packaged optics and Quantum photonic devices which we want to support in the best possible way. DTU therefore intends to purchase a reconfigurable, flexible, versatile machine. The purpose of the photonic wafer probe station is to characterise the quality of photonic integrated circuits (PICs). It should be possible to characterise both optical and electrical performance. For the optical characterisation, the main coupling in/out technique will be through grating couplers, but the equipment should be possible to be configured also for edge coupling to component facets in a grove on the wafer. In this case, different holders and fibres may be needed. The electrical characteristics are to be characterised both in DC as well as RF up to 40GHz using probe and/or probe cards. The system shall support research, development, process qualification, and routine characterization activities within DTU Nano's advanced fabrication facility.

title: Germany – Translation services – Translation works and services from EN into DE, FR and IT
description: The main deliverables to be provided consist of translation of documents, including amendments to translated documents and any subsequent version, from EN (English) into DE (German), FR (French) and IT (Italian). Translation (including translation from scratch and full post-editing) shall mean the rendering of the meaning of a source text into the Target language, producing a text that is complete, accurate and faithful (in terms of grammar, usage, readability, register and style), uses the appropriate terminology consistently, and conforms with all instructions provided for the assignment. Where translation memory matches and/or machine translation and large language model (LLM) output are provided, these shall be used as a basis for the work. The delivered text shall in its entirety be of the same quality as a professionally produced human translation and shall be suitable for publication or further use without requiring additional revision by the ECB. The works and services may also consist of: • revising texts in the Target language; Revision shall mean the review and, where necessary, correction of a translated text by comparison with the source text to ensure that the translation is complete, accurate, consistent and fit for purpose, and that it faithfully conveys the meaning of the original text while complying with the applicable linguistic, terminological and style requirements. • proof-reading texts in the Target language; Proof-reading shall mean the review of a translated text after it has been converted into a new digital format, with a view to identifying and correcting minor textual, typographical, formatting and layout errors, and ensuring that no content has been lost, altered or corrupted during the conversion process. • post-editing of machine translation output in the Target language; Post-editing shall be understood as light post-editing and shall mean the process of reviewing and correcting machine translation and/or LLM output and, where applicable, translation memory matches to ensure that the target text accurately conveys the meaning of the source text. The target languages are tendered in separate lots. Tenderers can submit offers for one, several or all lots.
